title: Gajerun maƙaloli
description: Ten short newspaper columns: advice for the harmattan cold, a letter about cancer found too late, healthy snacks instead of chocolate and cookies, gossip and incitement on social media, the religions of Hausaland living side by side, honest earnings in Ramadan, ambushes on the highways, an Independence Day look at politics, the disappearing wetlands, and a review of a Hausa detective novel.

lessons.title: Sanyin hunturu
lessons.summary: A health column on the harmattan cold in Kano: illnesses that emerge, sleeping under a blanket, boiling drinking water, the drowsiness and dozing at school and work, motorcycle riders in the cold dusty wind, and everyone eager for the warm season.
lessons.text:
A wannan mako, mai karatu, bari mu yi magana a kan sanyin hunturu. Daga watan Nuwamba zuwa watan Fabrairu, iska mai ƙura tana kaɗawa daga hamada, kuma da dare da kuma da safe sanyi yana ƙara ƙarfi a Kano da sauran garuruwan arewa. A irin wannan lokaci wasu cututtuka sukan kunno kai, kamar mura, tari da ciwon ƙirji.

Abu na farko shi ne ɗumin jiki. Kada ka kwanta ba tare da bargo ba. Idan bargo ɗaya bai isa ba, ka ƙara na biyu. Yara ƙanana da tsofaffi su ne suka fi buƙatar bargo mai kauri, saboda jikinsu ba ya iya jure sanyi kamar na matasa.

Abu na biyu shi ne ruwan sha. Mutane da yawa ba sa shan ruwa a lokacin sanyi, saboda ba sa jin ƙishirwa. Wannan kuskure ne. A tafasa ruwa, a bar shi ya ɗan huce, sannan a sha shi. Duk ruwan da za ka sha a wannan lokaci, ka tafasa shi da farko, domin ƙura tana shiga cikin ruwan da aka ajiye a waje.

Abu na uku shi ne kasala. A lokacin sanyi mutane da yawa sukan ji kasala. Da safe kowa yana so ya ci gaba da kwanciya a cikin bargonsa. Ɗalibai sukan yi gyangyaɗi a cikin aji, ma'aikata kuma sukan yi gyangyaɗi a ofis bayan abincin rana. Masana sun ce wannan kasala tana da alaƙa da rashin hasken rana da kuma rashin motsa jiki. Saboda haka, ku riƙa yin tafiya da safe, kuma ku yi barci da wuri da dare, don kada ku yi gyangyaɗi a wurin aiki.

Abu na huɗu, kuma mafi muhimmanci a ganina, shi ne hanya. Matasan da suke tuƙa mashin na haya su ne suka fi shan wahala a lokacin hunturu. Iska mai sanyi tana bugun fuskarsu, kuma ƙura tana rufe idanunsu har ba sa ganin hanya da kyau. Jiya na ga wani matashi a kan mashin, ba shi da hula ko riga mai kauri, yana rawar sanyi. Ina roƙon masu mashin su sa gilashin ido da riga mai kauri, kuma su rage gudu idan ƙura ta yi yawa.

A ƙarshe, mai karatu, na san ka ƙosa sanyin nan ya wuce. Ni ma na ƙosa lokacin zafi ya dawo, kuma yara sun ƙosa su fita wasa da yamma ba tare da riguna masu nauyi ba. Amma kafin nan, mu kula da kanmu da iyalanmu. Allah ya kai mu lokacin ɗumi lafiya.

Tambayoyi:
Waɗanne cututtuka ne sukan kunno kai a lokacin hunturu?
Mura, tari da ciwon ƙirji sukan kunno kai a lokacin hunturu.
Su wane ne suka fi buƙatar bargo mai kauri?
Yara ƙanana da tsofaffi su ne suka fi buƙatar bargo mai kauri.
Me ya sa za a tafasa ruwa kafin a sha shi?
Domin ƙura tana shiga cikin ruwan da aka ajiye a waje.
Yaya kasala take shafar ɗalibai da ma'aikata?
Ɗalibai sukan yi gyangyaɗi a cikin aji, ma'aikata kuma sukan yi gyangyaɗi a ofis.
Me marubucin ya roƙi masu mashin su yi?
Ya roƙe su su sa gilashin ido da riga mai kauri, kuma su rage gudu.

lessons.title: Sankara ba ta jiran kowa
lessons.summary: A Kaduna reader, Malama Habibatu, writes in grief that her mother died of breast cancer after hiding a lump until it swelled; the columnist explains that cancer is not a calamity nobody can fight nor something to wait for a miracle about, lists the warning signs, urges avoiding tobacco and checking the body early, since most women reach the hospital just before it is too late.
lessons.text:
A makon da ya gabata wata mai karatu daga Kaduna, Malama Habibatu, ta rubuto mana wasiƙa cike da alhini. Mahaifiyarta ta rasu sakamakon sankara ta mama. Ta rubuta cewa, "Shekara biyu da suka wuce mahaifiyata ta ga wani abu ya kumbura a jikinta, amma ba ta faɗa wa kowa ba. Sai da wurin ya ƙara kumbura sosai, sannan ta je asibiti. A lokacin, lokaci ya riga ya ƙure." Muna yi wa Malama Habibatu ta'aziyya, kuma muna tare da ita a cikin wannan alhini.

Wasiƙarta ce ta sa na rubuta wannan maƙala. Sankara cuta ce da ƙwayoyin jiki suke ƙaruwa ba bisa ƙa'ida ba. Akwai sankara ta mama, sankara ta huhu, sankara ta jini da sauransu. A ƙasarmu, mutane da yawa suna ganin sankara musiba ce daga Allah da ba za a iya yin komai a kanta ba. Wasu kuma suna zaune suna jiran mu'ujiza. Amma likitoci sun ce idan an gano sankara da wuri, ana iya magance ta.

Wane irin alamu ya kamata mutum ya lura da su? Na farko, idan wani wuri a jikinka ya kumbura ba tare da ciwo ba, kuma bai sauka ba bayan makonni, ka je asibiti. Na biyu, idan nauyinka yana raguwa ba tare da dalili ba, ko kana yawan tari mai jini. Na uku, idan wani rauni ya ƙi warkewa.

Akwai kuma abubuwan da ya kamata mu nisantar da kanmu daga gare su. Mafi girma shi ne taba sigari, wadda take haddasa sankara ta huhu. Bugu da ƙari, likitoci suna ba da shawarar nisantar abinci mai yawan mai, da kuma nisantar hayaƙin wutar itace a cikin ɗakin girki.

Wani likita a Kano ya faɗa min cewa yawancin matan da suke zuwa asibitinsa da sankara ta mama, suna zuwa ne daf da lokacin da ba za a iya yin komai ba. Ya ce, "Wata mace ta zo min jiya, cutar tana daf da wuce magani. Da ta zo shekara ɗaya da ta wuce, da mun cece ta." Asibitinsa yana daf da kasuwa, amma duk da haka mata ba sa zuwa sai lokaci ya ƙure.

Saboda haka ina roƙon mata su riƙa duba jikinsu kowane wata, maza kuma su riƙa zuwa asibiti don a duba su. Magani ba mu'ujiza ba ne; aiki ne na likita da na mara lafiya tare. Hausawa sun ce, "Rigakafi ya fi magani." Kada mu bari wata musiba irin wadda ta sami gidan Malama Habibatu ta sami wasu.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Malama Habibatu ta rubuto wasiƙa cike da alhini?
Saboda mahaifiyarta ta rasu sakamakon sankara ta mama.
Yaushe mahaifiyarta ta je asibiti?
Sai da wurin ya ƙara kumbura sosai, sannan ta je asibiti.
Yaya mutane da yawa suke ganin sankara?
Suna ganin ta musiba ce daga Allah, wasu kuma suna jiran mu'ujiza.
Me ya kamata mu nisantar da kanmu daga gare shi?
Mu nisantar da kanmu daga taba sigari da hayaƙin wutar itace.
Yaushe mata da yawa suke zuwa asibitin likitan?
Suna zuwa ne daf da lokacin da ba za a iya yin komai ba.

lessons.title: Abincin yara a makaranta
lessons.summary: A column to mothers: children want only chocolate and cookies, whose sweetness harms their teeth and health; the columnist gives a recipe for tiger-nut drink (soak, grind, filter) and a vegetable salad for lunch, and tells the mother the choice and the reward are hers.
lessons.text:
Uwar gida, kowace safiya kina ba yaranki kuɗi su sayi abinci a makaranta? Ko kina zuba musu abinci a cikin kwano? A wannan mako zan ba ki shawara game da abincin da yara suke ci a makaranta.

Yara da yawa yanzu ba sa son komai sai cakuleti da kukis da lemon kwalba. Iyaye sukan saya musu cakuleti saboda yana da sauƙi, kuma yaro yana farin ciki idan ya gan shi. Amma likitocin haƙori sun ce zaƙin cakuleti da na kukis yana lalata haƙoran yara. Bugu da ƙari, yawan zaƙi yana sa yara su yi ƙiba, kuma yana iya kawo ciwon sukari idan sun girma. Ba ina cewa kada yaro ya taɓa cin kukis ba; amma ya zama sau ɗaya a mako, ba kowace rana ba.

To, me za ki ba su? Ga hanya mai sauƙi ta yin kunun aya a gida. Da dare ki jiƙa aya a cikin ruwa mai tsabta. Ki bar ta a cikin ruwan har zuwa safiya, domin ta yi laushi. Idan ba ki jiƙa ta da kyau ba, ba za ta yi laushi ba. Da safe ki wanke ta, ki ƙara citta da kwakwa, sannan ki markaɗa su a inji. Idan babu inji, ana iya markaɗa su a dutse kamar yadda kakanninmu suke yi.

Bayan an markaɗa, sai a yi tacewa. Ki zuba ruwa a ciki, ki yi tacewa da tsumma mai tsabta, har ruwan ya rabu da dusar. Tacewa ita ce mafi muhimmanci a wannan aiki, domin yaro ba ya son kunu mai dusa. Zaƙin kunun aya na halitta ne, saboda haka ba ki buƙatar sukari da yawa. Ki zuba shi a cikin kwalba, ki saka shi a firiji.

Ga abincin rana kuma, ki haɗa wa yaronki salad na kabeji, karas, tumatir da kokwamba. Wasu yara ba sa son salad, amma idan kin yanka kayan lambun da kyau, kin zuba masa ɗan mai da lemo, za su so shi. Salad yana ƙara wa yaro lafiya, kuma ba ya lalata haƙora kamar cakuleti.

Uwar gida, zaɓi naki ne. Lafiyar yaranki tana hannunki. Idan yaro ya saba da kunun aya da salad tun yana ƙarami, ba zai riƙa kukan cakuleti ba idan ya girma. Aikin nan naki ne, kuma ladan ma naki ne.

Tambayoyi:
Me likitocin haƙori suka ce game da cakuleti da kukis?
Sun ce zaƙinsu yana lalata haƙoran yara.
Sau nawa yaro zai iya cin kukis?
Sau ɗaya a mako, ba kowace rana ba.
Me ya sa za a jiƙa aya da dare?
Domin ta yi laushi har zuwa safiya.
Me ake yi bayan an markaɗa aya?
Ana zuba ruwa, a yi tacewa da tsumma mai tsabta.
Da me ake haɗa salad?
Ana haɗa shi da kabeji, karas, tumatir da kokwamba.

lessons.title: Gulma a intanet
lessons.summary: A column on social media: anyone can upload a video in a minute, which brings back old-style gossip; people hide behind false names or behind humour, and some incite young men to violence; a Kano court sends a summons by email to a young man who uploaded a false video about the trader Hajiya Sahura, and he apologises.
lessons.text:
Shekaru goma da suka wuce, idan kana son aika saƙo mai muhimmanci, sai ka rubuta wasiƙa ko email. Yanzu kuwa kowa yana da waya, kuma kowa yana iya loda hoto ko bidiyo a intanet cikin minti ɗaya. Wannan ci gaba ne mai kyau: 'yan kasuwa suna tallata kayansu, ɗalibai suna karatu, iyalai suna ganin junansu. Amma a gefe guda, ya kawo wata tsohuwar matsala a sabon salo, wato gulma.

Gulma ita ce mutum ya yi magana a kan wani a bayansa, ko ya yaɗa labarin da bai tabbata ba. A da, gulma tana tsayawa a cikin unguwa ko a kasuwa. Yanzu kuwa idan wani ya loda bidiyon gulma, cikin dare ɗaya mutane dubu ɗari sun gani. Mutum ba zai iya kare kansa daga gulmar da ba ya ma san inda ta fito ba.

Wasu suna fakewa da sunayen ƙarya. Sukan buɗe shafi da sunan da ba nasu ba, sannan su yi ta zagin mutane. Wasu kuma suna fakewa da raha. Idan an kama su, sai su ce, "Ai raha nake yi." Raha tana da kyau; dariya tana rage damuwa. Amma rahar da take cutar da wani ba raha ba ce.

Mafi muni a cikinsu su ne masu tunzura jama'a. Wani yakan loda bidiyo yana cewa mutanen wata unguwa sun kai hari a kan wasu, domin ya tunzura matasa su ɗauki makami. Kafin a gane cewa ƙarya ce, an riga an yi faɗa, an ƙone gidaje.

Abin farin ciki, doka ta fara aiki. A watan da ya gabata, wata kotu a Kano ta aika da sammaci ga wani matashi da ya loda bidiyon ƙarya a kan wata 'yar kasuwa, Hajiya Sahura. Ya ce a cikin bidiyon cewa tana sayar da shinkafa marar kyau. An aika masa sammacin ta email, sannan 'yan sanda suka kai masa takardar sammaci a gida. Da ya ga sammacin, sai ya cire bidiyon, ya je kotu ya nemi gafara a gaban Hajiya Sahura. Ya ce ba ya son tunzura kowa; raha yake yi kawai. Alƙali ya ce masa, "Rahar da ta rage cinikin mutum, ba raha ba ce."

Mai karatu, kafin ka loda wani abu, ka tambayi kanka: gaskiya ne? Zai taimaki kowa? Idan ba haka ba, ka bar shi. Hausawa sun ce, "Komai nisan jifa, ƙasa zai faɗi." Abin da ka loda yau zai iya dawowa kanka gobe.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa gulma ta fi illa yanzu fiye da da?
Domin idan wani ya loda bidiyon gulma, cikin dare ɗaya mutane dubu ɗari sun gani.
Da me wasu suke fakewa?
Suna fakewa da sunayen ƙarya da kuma raha.
Me masu tunzura jama'a suke yi?
Suna loda bidiyo domin su tunzura matasa su ɗauki makami.
Ta yaya aka aika wa matashin sammaci?
An aika masa ta email, sannan 'yan sanda suka kai masa takardar a gida.
Me alƙalin ya ce game da raha?
Ya ce rahar da ta rage cinikin mutum ba raha ba ce.

lessons.title: Addinai a ƙasar Hausa
lessons.summary: A column on religion in Hausaland: before Islam many practised bori, then came the Quranic schools; Christian missionaries later preached the gospel and built schools and hospitals; today some preachers call others' faith unbelief, but intermarriage has long tied families together, and in Jos Pastor Daniel and Malam Umaru teach that everyone is equal before the law.
lessons.text:
A wannan mako zan yi magana a kan wani abu da yake da muhimmanci a rayuwarmu: addini. Ƙasar Hausa ta daɗe tana da addinai iri iri, kuma tarihinsu yana koya mana yadda za mu zauna tare.

Kafin zuwan Musulunci, Hausawa da yawa suna bin addinin gargajiya, kuma daga cikinsa akwai bori. A cikin bori, mutane suna ganin cewa iskoki suna shiga jikin mutum, sai a yi kiɗa da rawa. Har yau akwai masu yin bori a wasu ƙauyuka, ko da yake ba su da yawa kamar da.

Daga baya Musulunci ya zo ta hannun 'yan kasuwa da malamai. Aka buɗe makarantun tsangaya, inda yara suke koyon karatun Alƙur'ani a wurin malaminsu. Tsangaya ta zama tushen ilimi a ƙasar Hausa tsawon ƙarnuka.

A ƙarni na ashirin, 'yan mishan daga Turai suka zo arewa. Aikin mishan ba wa'azi kaɗai ba ne; 'yan mishan sun gina makarantu da asibitoci a wurare da yawa. Sun yi wa'azin bishara, wato labarin Yesu kamar yadda Kiristoci suka yi imani. Mutane da yawa a kudancin Kaduna da Filato sun karɓi wannan bishara. A yau kowane gari a arewa yana da masallatai da coci, da malamai da fastoci.

Wannan bambanci bai kamata ya raba mu ba. Amma abin takaici, akwai wasu masu wa'azi, a ɓangarorin biyu, da suke kiran addinin wasu kafirci, suna cewa mabiyansa ba su da wuri a cikin al'umma. Irin wannan magana tana sa matasa su ga juna a matsayin abokan gaba. Faɗin cewa wani addini kafirci ne a cikin masallaci ko coci abu ɗaya ne; amfani da kalmar don cutar da maƙwabci wani abu ne daban.

A gefe guda, auratayya ta daɗe tana haɗa kawunan mutane. A Jos da Kaduna akwai iyalai da yawa da kakanninsu suka fito daga ƙabilu daban daban. Saboda auratayya, a gida ɗaya za ka sami Musulmi da Kirista, amma duk suna zuwa bikin juna.

Kwanan nan na ziyarci wani shiri a Jos, inda wani fasto, Fasto Daniel, da wani malami, Malam Umaru, suke koya wa matasa zaman lafiya tare. Fasto Daniel ya ce, "Ba aikina ba ne in kira addinin wani kafirci. Aikina shi ne in yi wa'azin bishara cikin lumana. Tsarin mulkin ƙasarmu ya ba kowa daidaici a gaban doka. Kirista da Musulmi duk 'yan ƙasa ne." Malam Umaru ya ƙara da cewa, "Daidaici a gaban doka ba yana nufin addinanmu ɗaya ba ne; yana nufin haƙƙinmu ɗaya ne."

Tambayoyi:
Me ake yi a cikin bori?
Ana ganin cewa iskoki suna shiga jikin mutum, sai a yi kiɗa da rawa.
Me yara suke koyo a makarantun tsangaya?
Suna koyon karatun Alƙur'ani a wurin malaminsu.
Me 'yan mishan suka gina a arewa?
Sun gina makarantu da asibitoci a wurare da yawa.
Me ya sa marubucin ya ce auratayya tana haɗa kawunan mutane?
Saboda iyalai da yawa sun fito daga ƙabilu daban daban, kuma duk suna zuwa bikin juna.
Me Fasto Daniel ya ce game da daidaici?
Ya ce tsarin mulkin ƙasa ya ba kowa daidaici a gaban doka.

lessons.title: Arziki na halal
lessons.summary: A Ramadan column: night prayers and humility mean nothing if earnings are not halal; the columnist warns against the hypocrite who prays extra prayers in public but cheats in the market, against betting on football and card games, against stinginess and looking at others' faults, and calls on readers to start afresh this month.
lessons.text:
Mun shiga watan Ramadan, watan da kowa yake ƙara ibada. Masallatai sun cika, mutane suna yin sallar nafila da dare, suna karanta Alƙur'ani. Wannan abin farin ciki ne. Amma a wannan mako ina so mu tambayi kanmu wata tambaya: abincin da muke buɗa baki da shi, na halal ne?

Babu ma'ana mutum ya tsaya yana sallar nafila har tsakar dare, sannan da safe ya je kasuwa ya cuci mutane. Malaman addini sun ce wanda yake nuna ibada a gaban mutane, amma zuciyarsa ba ta tare da ita, munafuki ne. Munafuki yana faɗin abu ɗaya, yana aikata wani. Nafila ba ta wanke kuɗin da aka samu ta hanyar cuta.

Wata hanya da matasa da yawa suke neman kuɗin da ba na halal ba a yau ita ce fare. Kowace rana matasa suna zuwa shagunan fare suna sa kuɗi a kan wasan ƙwallon ƙafa na Turai. Wani matashi ya faɗa min cewa ya ci naira dubu goma a fare ɗaya, amma a cikin wata ɗaya ya yi asarar dubu ɗari. Haka kuma akwai masu zama a ƙarƙashin bishiya da dare suna caca da kati. Ɗaya yana lale katunan, sauran suna jira, kowa yana fatan sa'a ta same shi.

Bayan haka, akwai rowa. Wasu masu kuɗi suna da abinci fiye da abin da za su ci, amma maƙwabcinsu yana kwana da yunwa. Rowa a watan Ramadan aibu ne babba. Annabi ya koya mana mu ciyar da masu azumi.

Wani abin da ya kamata mu bari shi ne neman aibun wasu. Wani yakan ga ƙaramin aibu a jikin ɗan uwansa, amma ba ya ganin babban aibun da ke jikinsa. A nan ne tawali'u yake da amfani. Mai tawali'u ba ya ganin ya fi kowa; yana sanin cewa shi ma yana da kurakurai.

Mai karatu, Ramadan lokaci ne na sake lale. Kamar yadda mai caca yake sake lale katunansa idan wasa ya ɓaci, haka mu ma za mu iya sake fara rayuwarmu a wannan wata. Mu bar fare da cuta, mu nemi abin da yake na halal, mu ciyar da maƙwabtanmu, mu ƙara tawali'u. Allah ya karɓi ibadarmu.

Tambayoyi:
Wace tambaya marubucin yake so mu yi wa kanmu?
Yana so mu tambayi kanmu ko abincin da muke buɗa baki da shi na halal ne.
Wane ne munafuki a cewar malamai?
Shi ne wanda yake nuna ibada a gaban mutane, amma zuciyarsa ba ta tare da ita.
Nawa matashin ya yi asara a fare a cikin wata ɗaya?
Ya yi asarar naira dubu ɗari.
Me ya sa rowa a watan Ramadan aibu ne?
Saboda maƙwabci yana kwana da yunwa, kuma Annabi ya koya mana mu ciyar da masu azumi.
Me mai tawali'u yake sani?
Yana sanin cewa shi ma yana da kurakurai.

lessons.title: Kwanton ɓauna a kan hanya
lessons.summary: A column on highway security between Gusau and Funtua: militants hide in the grass, attack vehicles and set ambushes, using a derelict building at the entrance to a village as a hideout; the driver Malam Rabe tells how soldiers in uniform came with sirens and stood firm, and the columnist asks the government to clear the ruins and guard the entrances to towns.
lessons.text:
Duk wanda ya bi hanyar Gusau zuwa Funtua a 'yan shekarun nan ya san cewa tafiyar ba ta da daɗi. Tsageru da suke cikin daji sukan fito su tare hanya, su kwashe kayan matafiya, wani lokaci kuma su sace mutane domin a biya kuɗin fansa.

Hanyar da tsageru suka fi amfani da ita ita ce kwanto. Sukan ɓoye a cikin ciyayi a gefen hanya, suna jiran mota ta zo. Idan motar ta zo daf da su, sai su afka mata da bindigogi. Ana kiran wannan dabara kwanton ɓauna, domin tana kama da yadda ɓauna take ɓoyewa a cikin ciyawa kafin ta afka wa abin da take so.

A makon da ya gabata na yi magana da wani direban mota, Malam Rabe, wanda ya tsira daga irin wannan kwanto. Ya ce, "Muna isowa mashigin wani ƙauye, sai muka ga itace a kan hanya. Kafin in tsaya, sai tsageru suka fito daga wani kango da ke gefen hanya. Suka afka wa motarmu, suka umarce mu mu fito."

Wannan kango tsohon gidan mai ne da aka daina amfani da shi shekaru da yawa. Babu kowa a cikinsa, ba shi da ƙofa, kuma ciyayi sun rufe shi. Mutanen ƙauyen sun ce tsageru suna kwana a cikin kangon, suna kallon hanya daga nan. Wani lokaci ma sukan sa kaki irin na soja, domin matafiya su ɗauka sojoji ne.

Malam Rabe ya ci gaba da cewa, "Ba a daɗe ba sai muka ji jiniya. Motocin sojoji ne suka iso. Sojojin sanye da kaki suka sauka, suka fara harbi. Tsageru suka gudu cikin daji." Ya ce sojojin sun tsaya daram a kan hanya har sai da aka fitar da dukan matafiya daga wurin lafiya. Duk da cewa an harbe wani soja a ƙafa, bai bar wurinsa ba; ya tsaya daram tare da abokan aikinsa.

Mai karatu, ina yaba wa sojojin nan masu sanye da kaki da suke kare mu, kuma ya kamata mu ma mu tsaya daram tare da su. Amma ba za mu bar komai a hannunsu ba. Ina roƙon gwamnati ta yi abubuwa uku. Na farko, a rushe duk wani kango da ke gefen manyan hanyoyi, don kada tsageru su sami wurin ɓoyewa. Na biyu, a sa jami'an tsaro a kowane mashigi na gari da ƙauye, domin su riƙa duba motocin da suke shiga. Na uku, a ba al'ummomin ƙauyuka lambar waya da za su kira idan sun ga baƙi a cikin daji. Idan mutane suka ji jiniya da wuri, tsageru ba za su sami damar yin kwanto ba.

Tambayoyi:
Me tsageru suke yi a hanyar Gusau zuwa Funtua?
Suna tare hanya, suna kwashe kayan matafiya, suna sace mutane.
Me ya sa ake kiran dabarar kwanton ɓauna?
Domin tana kama da yadda ɓauna take ɓoyewa a cikin ciyawa kafin ta afka wa abin da take so.
Daga ina tsageru suka fito a labarin Malam Rabe?
Sun fito daga wani kango da ke gefen hanya.
Me Malam Rabe ya ji kafin sojoji su iso?
Ya ji jiniya.
Me marubucin yake so a yi a kowane mashigi na gari?
Yana so a sa jami'an tsaro a kowane mashigi, domin su riƙa duba motocin da suke shiga.

lessons.title: Ranar 'yancin kai
lessons.summary: An Independence Day column: the parade in Abuja, then a look back: soldiers overthrew governments and disrupted the nation's politics; today politicians promise one agenda before the election and follow another, influence voters with money and achieve little, while the stalwarts of the past served the whole country; the columnist calls on young people to vote for programmes, not money.
lessons.text:
Ranar ɗaya ga watan Oktoba ce ranar 'yancin kan Najeriya. Kamar kowace shekara, a bana an yi fareti a Abuja. Sojoji da 'yan sanda da ɗaliban makarantu sun yi fareti a gaban shugaban ƙasa, jama'a kuma suna kallo a talabijin. Fareti abu ne mai kyau; yana tuna mana cewa mun sami 'yanci daga Ingila a shekarar 1960. Amma bayan an gama fareti, ya kamata mu tambayi kanmu: me muka yi da wannan 'yanci?

Tarihinmu bai yi sauƙi ba. Shekaru shida kacal bayan 'yancin kai, sojoji suka kifar da gwamnatin farar hula. Daga nan aka yi ta kifar da gwamnati ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Duk lokacin da sojoji suka kifar da wata gwamnati, sukan ce sun zo ne su gyara ƙasa. Amma juyin mulki ya dagula siyasar ƙasar, ya dagula tattalin arziki, kuma ya hana mu koyon yadda ake gudanar da dimokuraɗiyya.

Yanzu muna da dimokuraɗiyya fiye da shekaru ashirin. Amma akwai sabuwar matsala. 'Yan siyasa da yawa sukan zo da wata ajanda kafin zaɓe: hanyoyi, asibitoci, ruwan sha, aikin yi ga matasa. Bayan sun ci zaɓe, sai su bi wata ajanda daban, ta neman kuɗi ga kansu da iyalansu. Wasu kuma suna rinjayar masu zaɓe da kuɗi. Sukan raba naira dubu biyu ko buhun shinkafa ranar zaɓe, domin su rinjayar da talaka ya zaɓe su. Sakamakon haka, bayan shekaru huɗu, ba su taɓuka komai ba. Idan ka tambaye su me suka taɓuka, sai su ce babu kuɗi.

Ba haka abin yake a da ba. Mun sami zaratan 'yan siyasa a farkon 'yancin kai, mutanen da suka yi aiki domin ƙasa bakiɗaya, ba domin ƙabilarsu ko garinsu kaɗai ba. Kowane zarto daga cikinsu yana da littafin manufofinsa, kuma jama'a sun san abin da zai yi idan ya ci zaɓe. Ba duk abin da suka yi ne daidai ba, amma sun yi ƙoƙari su gina Najeriya bakiɗaya.

Matasa, ku ne yawancin masu zaɓe a ƙasar nan. Kada ku bari kowa ya rinjayar da ku da kuɗi. Kafin zaɓe, ku nemi ajandar kowane ɗan takara, ku karanta ta, ku tambaye shi yadda zai cika ta. Wanda bai taɓuka komai ba a da, kada ku sake zaɓensa. Ta haka ne kawai fareti na ranar 'yancin kai zai zama na gaskiya.

Tambayoyi:
Su wane ne suka yi fareti a Abuja?
Sojoji da 'yan sanda da ɗaliban makarantu sun yi fareti a gaban shugaban ƙasa.
Me sojoji suka yi shekaru shida bayan 'yancin kai?
Sun kifar da gwamnatin farar hula.
Me juyin mulki ya dagula?
Ya dagula siyasar ƙasar da tattalin arziki.
Ta yaya wasu 'yan siyasa suke rinjayar masu zaɓe?
Suna raba kuɗi ko buhun shinkafa ranar zaɓe.
Me ya bambanta zaratan 'yan siyasa na da?
Sun yi aiki domin ƙasa bakiɗaya, kuma kowane zarto yana da littafin manufofinsa.

lessons.title: Dausayin da muke rasawa
lessons.summary: An environment column on the Hadejia-Nguru wetlands: the marsh once gave fish, rice and frogs, and women drew water from it; dams upstream and chemical spraying are drying and poisoning it, harvests have fallen by tons, and the columnist asks the government to lay the foundation for a plan to save it, suggesting farmers use husk and bark mulch instead of spraying.
lessons.text:
A arewacin Kano da Jigawa akwai wani babban dausayi da ake kira dausayin Hadejia da Nguru. Shekaru da yawa wannan dausayi ya kasance tushen rayuwar dubban mutane. Masunta suna kama kifi a cikinsa, manoma suna noman shinkafa a gefensa, makiyaya kuma suna kawo shanunsu su ci ciyawa a lokacin rani. Tsuntsaye daga Turai ma sukan zo su yi hunturu a cikinsa.

Wani tsoho a Nguru ya faɗa min cewa, "Lokacin ina yaro, da dare ba ka iya barci saboda kukan kwaɗi. Kwaɗo yana ko'ina a cikin dausayi." Mata kuma suna zuwa da safe don ɗibar ruwa a cikin tuluna, saboda ruwan dausayin yana da tsabta. Yau kuwa kwaɗo ya zama abin ban mamaki, kuma matan da suke zuwa ɗibar ruwa suna tafiya nisa kafin su same shi.

Me ya faru? Akwai dalilai biyu. Na farko, shekaru arba'in da suka wuce aka aza tubalin farko na madatsun ruwa a kan kogunan da suke kawo ruwa zuwa dausayi. Yanzu ruwan da yake isowa ya ragu sosai. Na biyu, feshin magungunan ƙwari. Manoma da yawa yanzu suna feshi a gonakinsu sau da yawa a shekara. Idan aka yi ruwan sama, maganin da aka yi feshi da shi yana gudu zuwa cikin dausayi, yana kashe kifi da kwaɗo.

Sakamakon haka a bayyane yake. Wani jami'in gona ya ce shekaru ashirin da suka wuce, ƙauye ɗaya yana samun girbin ton ɗari na shinkafa a shekara. Yanzu ba su wuce ton talatin ba. Kifin da ake kamawa ma ya ragu da ton da yawa.

Mene ne mafita? A ganina, dole gwamnati ta aza harsashin wani babban shiri na ceton dausayin. Idan aka aza harsashi mai kyau, shirin zai daɗe. Ya kamata a kafa dokar da za ta tabbatar da cewa madatsun ruwa suna sakin isasshen ruwa kowace shekara. Bugu da ƙari, a koya wa manoma hanyoyin da ba sa buƙatar feshi mai yawa. Misali, ana iya rufe ƙasar gona da ɓawon shinkafa da ɓawon gyaɗa, ko da ɓawon itace da aka niƙa. Wannan ɓawo yana riƙe ruwa a cikin ƙasa, kuma yana hana ciyawa girma, ba tare da guba ba.

Mai karatu, dausayi ba ƙasa marar amfani ba ce. Dukiya ce da Allah ya ba mu. Idan muka rasa ta, mun rasa abinci, ruwa da rayuwar dubban mutane.

Tambayoyi:
Me mutane suke samu daga dausayin Hadejia da Nguru?
Suna samun kifi, shinkafa da ciyawa ga shanu.
Me ya sa tsohon ya ce ba ka iya barci da dare a lokacin yarintarsa?
Saboda kukan kwaɗi a cikin dausayi.
Me ya sa mata suke zuwa ɗibar ruwa a dausayi?
Saboda ruwan dausayin yana da tsabta.
Yaya feshin magungunan ƙwari yake cutar da dausayi?
Idan aka yi ruwan sama, maganin yana gudu zuwa cikin dausayi, yana kashe kifi da kwaɗo.
Ton nawa na shinkafa ƙauyen yake samu yanzu?
Ba su wuce ton talatin ba.

lessons.title: Sabon littafin bincike
lessons.summary: A book review column: the second edition of Malama Hamidatu's detective novel tells of a rich trader found dead in his shop in a big Kano market and Inspector Bulama's search for the killer; the beginning bewilders the reader, but the book has drawbacks such as printing errors; the actor's role in the coming Kannywood film, and the columnist urges writers to make a real effort.
lessons.text:
A wannan mako na karanta ɗab'i na biyu na wani sabon littafin bincike na Malama Hamidatu, wata matashiyar marubuciya daga Kano. Ɗab'i na farko ya ƙare a kasuwa cikin wata uku kacal, kuma wannan sabon ɗab'i ya fi na farko kyau.

Mafarin labarin shi ne mutuwar wani attajiri a wata babbar kasuwa a Kano. Da safe aka same shi ya mutu a cikin shagonsa, ƙofar kuma a rufe daga ciki. Wane ne makashi? Ta yaya makashi ya fita daga shagon da ƙofarsa take a rufe? Sufeto Bulama, wani tsohon ɗan sanda mai hikima, shi ne ya karɓi aikin bincike.

Abin da ya fi burge ni a littafin shi ne yadda marubuciyar ta gina mafari mai ƙarfi. Daga shafin farko, mai karatu yana so ya san amsar. Bayan haka, kowane babi yana kawo sabon mutum da zai iya zama makashi: ɗan attajirin, matarsa ta biyu, abokin kasuwancinsa, da yaron shagon. Na ɗimauta sosai. Kowane lokaci da na ce na gane makashi, sai wani sabon abu ya sake ɗimauta ni. Sufeto Bulama ma ya ɗimauta a wani wuri, har ya kusa ya bar binciken.

Duk da haka, littafin yana da naƙasu. Naƙasu na farko shi ne kurakuran bugu. A shafuka da dama, haruffa sun ɓace ko an maimaita kalmomi. Wannan laifin kamfanin da ya buga ɗab'in ne, ba na marubuciyar ba. Naƙasu na biyu shi ne cewa ƙarshen labarin ya yi gaggawa. Bayan shafuka ɗari biyu na bincike, sai aka bayyana komai a shafi uku.

Labari mai daɗi shi ne cewa wani kamfani a Kannywood ya sayi damar yin fim da littafin. Na ji cewa wani shahararren jarumi zai taka rol ɗin Sufeto Bulama. Wannan rol ba mai sauƙi ba ne, domin Bulama mutum ne mai shiru, mai tunani, ba mai faɗa ba. Ina fatan jarumin zai fahimci rol ɗin da kyau.

A ƙarshe, ina kira ga sauran marubutanmu su zage damtse. Mai karatun Hausa yana son labaran bincike, amma ba su da yawa. Idan marubuta suka zage damtse, suka rubuta da kyau, kuma kamfanoni suka kula da bugu, littattafanmu za su yi gogayya da na kowace ƙasa.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya faru da ɗab'i na farko na littafin?
Ya ƙare a kasuwa cikin wata uku kacal.
Mene ne mafarin labarin?
Mafarin labarin shi ne mutuwar wani attajiri a wata babbar kasuwa a Kano.
Me ya sa marubucin ya ɗimauta?
Domin kowane babi yana kawo sabon mutum da zai iya zama makashi.
Waɗanne naƙasu ne littafin yake da su?
Yana da kurakuran bugu, kuma ƙarshen labarin ya yi gaggawa.
Me marubucin yake kira ga sauran marubuta su yi?
Yana kira gare su su zage damtse su rubuta da kyau.
